result.topic_en: Heavily corrected draft of a report on General-Lieutenant Baeyer's proposals for the Central European arc measurement. It covers Hanover's possible contribution of new latitude and longitude determinations, the value of telegraphic longitude determination via connecting the Göttingen observatory to the telegraph network, and definitions concerning the figure of the earth (geoid, ellipsoid, deflection of the vertical).
